card.name: Commas and linking words in lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words and commas partway through a list or fixed phrase, such as the comma after 'diarrhea' in the hepatotoxicity symptom list, or 'the' and 'in' inside a set title.

modes.label: Linking word in a phrase
modes.description: A word such as 'the' or 'in' that joins items or sits in a table title.

modes.label: Noun in clinical phrase
modes.description: A noun like 'patients' or 'pain' in a standard clinical phrase.
